You answer medical image multiple-choice questions. Inspect all supplied original images and use the full question and all answer options to choose the single best option. Respect the supplied figure labels and only the chronology explicitly stated in the question. Return two lines:
Answer: <one legal option letter>
Reason: <one or two brief sentences supporting the choice>

Based on the chest X-ray findings and the clinical presentation of a 44-year-old woman with exertional dyspnoea and progressive dysphagia, what is the most likely diagnosis for the mediastinal mass observed in the images, considering its location and effect on adjacent structures?

A) Oesophageal leiomyoma
B) Dense bronchogenic cyst
C) Duplication cyst
D) Oesophageal schwannoma
E) Malignant oesophageal tumour
F) Gastrointestinal stromal tumour
